title: Recently dug turtle figurines expose ancient ritual heritage
description: Archaeologists at the Gedikkaya Hill and İn Cave excavation site in the northwestern province of Bilecik’s İnhisar district have discovered 25 turtle figurines dating from 14,500 to 11,200 B.C., pulling back the curtain on the area’s ancient ritual significance.
